# BrainDAW Web

BrainDAW combines stereo brainwave tones, recorded nature, and generative synth pads in one mixer. This release adds Bedtime Drift, Return to Sleep, and Speaker Mix to the Lucid Dreaming collection. The searchable library now contains 33 factory presets for meditation, focus, sleep, dreamwork, and psychedelic-inspired sound design. In-app research notes describe the evidence and its limits.

Open the [hosted studio](https://rmanmetaverse.github.io/BrainDAW/) or serve the contents of `BrainDAW-Web.zip` over HTTPS or localhost. Install the PWA from a supported browser. After the app finishes caching, the included audio and worklets can load offline.

The release workflow verifies the production build, first-click audio, mobile layout, preset and timeline persistence, and offline playback.
